description: Keeps every pinned version current, as in the backend: npm packages, Node (.node-version), GitHub Actions, the Dockerfile's Caddy image and the tools the Makefile and workflows pin.

customManagers.description: A `# renovate: datasource=<d> depName=<name>` comment pins the version on the next line: the value after its first `:=`, `=` or `:`.

packageRules.description: npm packages, minor and patch, in one PR
Node: .node-version (which the Makefile, the Dockerfile and CI read), and the node image, in one PR
ESLint stays on 9 until eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y supports 10 (spec, Repo conventions)
TypeScript moves to 7 only once typescript-eslint and openapi-typescript support it (ADR-0001)
The tools the Makefile and the workflows pin by comment, in one PR
